content:
Sorting একটি এমন feature যা UI-তে সহজ মনে হয়, কিন্তু backend-এ একটু ভুল হলেই user-এর বিশ্বাস ভেঙে যায়। "Price: Low to High" select করলেও যদি তালিকার শুরুতে দামি product দেখায়, user মনে করবেন data ভুল — আর সেটা আসলে sort logic-এর bug।

Sorting bug অনেক সময় QA checklist-এর শেষে থাকে, কারণ "data তো আসছে" — এটুকু দেখেই pass mark দেওয়া হয়। কিন্তু Production-এ sort-related complaint বেশ common: pagination-এর পর page ভেঙে যাওয়া, null value যেখান-সেখান, Bengali name ভুল order-এ — এগুলো user experience-কে directly impact করে।

নিচে Sorting API-এর জন্য একটি সম্পূর্ণ, production-ready test suite দেওয়া হলো। সব test case text format-এ লেখা — code block ছাড়াই, professional QA documentation style-এ।

---

Sorting API বুঝে নেওয়া — Test করার আগে

বেশিরভাগ REST API-তে sorting দুইটি parameter দিয়ে control হয়:

  • sort — কোন field দিয়ে sort হবে (price, name, createdAt)
  • order — ascending (asc) নাকি descending (desc)

কিছু API comma-separated multi-column sort support করে — যেমন sort=category,price&order=asc,desc। কিছু API শুধু sort=price_asc format ব্যবহার করে। Test suite শুরু করার আগে API documentation থেকে exact syntax confirm করুন — assumption-এ test লিখলে false positive/negative হবে।

Sort Type উদাহরণ Field সাধারণ সমস্যা
Numericprice, quantity, ratingString হিসেবে sort হলে "10" < "2" হয়
Alphabeticname, categoryCase sensitivity, locale collation
DateTimecreatedAt, updatedAtTimezone, millisecond precision
BooleanisActive, isFeaturedtrue/false order documented কিনা
ComputeddiscountPercent, relevanceScoreRuntime calculation inconsistency
---

Basic Sorting Test Cases

প্রতিটি supported sort field-এর জন্য asc ও desc — দুটো direction-ই verify করুন। শুধু এক direction test করলে half coverage।

TC-SORT-001: Price Ascending Sort

Endpoint: GET /api/products?sort=price&order=asc

Expected Result: Status 200 OK। Response array-তে প্রথম item-এর price সবচেয়ে কম, শেষ item-এর price সবচেয়ে বেশি। প্রতিটি consecutive pair-এ previous price <= next price maintain হবে।

TC-SORT-002: Price Descending Sort

Query: sort=price&order=desc

Expected Result: প্রথম item সবচেয়ে দামি, শেষ item সবচেয়ে সস্তা। প্রতিটি pair-এ previous price >= next price।

TC-SORT-003: Name A-Z Sort

Query: sort=name&order=asc

Expected Result: Alphabetical order-এ name sorted। Case-insensitive behavior documented থাকলে "Apple" এবং "banana" সঠিক position-এ। Special character (hyphen, apostrophe) সহ name gracefully handle হবে।

TC-SORT-004: Name Z-A Sort

Query: sort=name&order=desc

Expected Result: Reverse alphabetical order। Ascending-এর exact opposite sequence।

TC-SORT-005: Date Sort — Newest First

Query: sort=createdAt&order=desc

Expected Result: সবচেয়ে recent record প্রথমে। Timestamp ISO 8601 format-এ compare হবে। Same day-এর multiple record থাকলে time portion অনুযায়ী sub-sort হবে।

TC-SORT-006: Date Sort — Oldest First

Query: sort=createdAt&order=asc

Expected Result: Oldest record প্রথমে। Historical data export বা audit view-এ common requirement।

TC-SORT-007: Rating / Popularity Sort

Query: sort=rating&order=desc

Expected Result: Highest rated item প্রথমে। Decimal rating (4.8, 4.75) numeric comparison-এ সঠিক order।

---

Locale, Collation & Special Character Tests

English-only dataset-এ sort pass হলেও Bengali বা mixed-language data-তে fail হতে পারে — এটা advanced QA-র critical area।

TC-SORT-008: Bengali Name Sorting

Scenario: Product name-এ বাংলা text আছে — "আপেল", "কলা", "আম"।

Expected Result: Bengali alphabetical order (অ-ঔ) অনুযায়ী sorted — random byte order নয়। Documentation-এ Bengali collation support mention থাকলে verify; না থাকলে documented limitation হিসেবে note করুন।

TC-SORT-009: Mixed Script Sorting

Scenario: Dataset-এ English, Bengali, এবং numeric prefix mixed — "iPhone 15", "Samsung Galaxy", "১০০ টাকা Discount"।

Expected Result: Consistent, predictable order — crash বা random shuffle হবে না। Order documented behavior অনুযায়ী (Unicode code point vs locale-aware)।

TC-SORT-010: Case Sensitivity Verification

Scenario: Names: "apple", "Apple", "APPLE", "Banana"।

Expected Result: API spec অনুযায়ী — case-insensitive হলে সব "apple" variant একসাথে group হবে; case-sensitive হলে uppercase/lowercase separate block-এ sort হবে। Spec-এর সাথে mismatch হলে bug।

TC-SORT-011: Leading/Trailing Whitespace

Scenario: Name field-এ " Product A" (leading space) এবং "Product B"।

Expected Result: Trimmed comparison হবে — whitespace-এর কারণে unexpected order change হবে না।

TC-SORT-012: Special Characters in Sort Field

Scenario: Names: "O'Brien", "Zebra", "@Special", "#HashProduct"।

Expected Result: Special character সহ name sort-এ server error হবে না। Position predictable হবে — spec-এ define না থাকলেও consistent order maintain হবে।

---

NULL, Empty & Tie-Breaking Tests

Real-world data কখনো perfect নয়। Null handling এবং equal value tie-breaking — দুটোই sort bug-এর hidden source।

TC-SORT-013: NULL Value Sorting — Ascending

Scenario: কিছু product-এ price null (price on request)।

Expected Result: Null value consistent position-এ — সবসময় last (ascending-এ) অথবা first — API documentation অনুযায়ী। Null items random middle-এ appear হবে না।

TC-SORT-014: NULL Value Sorting — Descending

Query: sort=price&order=desc (null price items আছে)

Expected Result: Ascending-এর mirror behavior — documented position-এ null items। Asc ও desc-এ null position logically consistent।

TC-SORT-015: Empty String vs NULL

Scenario: কিছু record-এ name = "" (empty string), কিছুতে name = null।

Expected Result: Empty string এবং null আলাদা treat হবে অথবা same group-এ — documented behavior। Unexpected interleaving হবে না।

TC-SORT-016: Tie-Breaking — Equal Price

Scenario: 5টি product same price = 500 — sort=price&order=asc।

Expected Result: Equal price items-এর secondary sort key apply হবে — সাধারণত name বা id। Same request repeat করলে same order (stable sort) — random shuffle acceptable নয় যদি spec-এ stability claim থাকে।

TC-SORT-017: Tie-Breaking — Equal Date

Scenario: Multiple record same createdAt timestamp (bulk import)।

Expected Result: Secondary key (id/name) দিয়ে deterministic order। Pagination-এ duplicate বা skip হবে না।

---

Invalid Input & Validation Tests

Sort parameter user-controlled — invalid input gracefully reject করতে হবে, silent fallback dangerous।

TC-SORT-018: Invalid Sort Field

Query: sort=nonExistentField&order=asc

Expected Result: 400 Bad Request, message: "Invalid sort field." Random ordering বা 500 Internal Server Error acceptable নয় — security risk (column enumeration) ও data leak-এর সম্ভাবনা।

TC-SORT-019: SQL Injection via Sort Parameter

Query: sort=price;DROP TABLE products--&order=asc

Expected Result: 400 Bad Request — injection execute হবে না। Whitelist validation কাজ করছে কিনা verify।

TC-SORT-020: Invalid Order Direction

Query: sort=price&order=sideways

Expected Result: 400 Bad Request, "Sort order must be 'asc' or 'desc'." Silent default apply করা documented না হলে bug।

TC-SORT-021: Missing Order Parameter

Query: sort=price (order missing)

Expected Result: Documented default order apply — সাধারণত asc। Response consistent হবে প্রতিবার। API spec-এ default clearly mention থাকবে।

TC-SORT-022: Missing Sort Parameter

Query: order=asc (sort missing)

Expected Result: 400 Bad Request অথবা default sort field apply — documented behavior। Undefined behavior acceptable নয়।

TC-SORT-023: Empty Sort Value

Query: sort=&order=asc

Expected Result: 400 Bad Request — empty sort silently ignore করে random data return acceptable নয়।

TC-SORT-024: Deprecated Sort Field

Scenario: API v2-তে sortBy deprecated, sort use করতে হবে।

Expected Result: Deprecated parameter use করলে warning header অথবা 400 with migration message। Silent ignore acceptable নয় — backward compatibility documented থাকলে exception।

TC-SORT-025: Sort Field Whitelist Enforcement

Query: sort=password&order=asc (internal/sensitive field)

Expected Result: 400 Bad Request — sensitive field sort-এ expose হবে না। Internal column name leak হবে না error message-এ।

---

Numeric & Data Type Sorting Tests

TC-SORT-026: String vs Numeric Sort Trap

Scenario: Prices stored as string: "9", "10", "100", "2"।

Expected Result: Numeric sort হলে order: 2, 9, 10, 100। String sort হলে: 10, 100, 2, 9 — যদি string sort হয়, documentation-এ clearly mention থাকতে হবে; user expectation numeric হলে critical bug।

TC-SORT-027: Negative Number Sorting

Scenario: Values: -50, -10, 0, 10, 100 — sort=amount&order=asc

Expected Result: Correct numeric order: -50, -10, 0, 10, 100। Negative value string comparison-এ ভুল position-এ যাবে না।

TC-SORT-028: Floating Point Precision

Scenario: Prices: 9.99, 10.00, 10.01, 10.1

Expected Result: 10.00 এবং 10.1 equal treat হবে না unless documented। Decimal precision maintain করে sort।

TC-SORT-029: Boolean Field Sort

Query: sort=isFeatured&order=desc

Expected Result: Featured (true) items প্রথমে। true/false order documented — asc-তে false first নাকি true first clearly defined।

---

Sort + Filter + Search Combined Tests

Production-এ sort কখনো isolated থাকে না — filter ও search-এর সাথে combine হয়।

TC-SORT-030: Sort + Category Filter

Query: category=electronics&sort=price&order=asc

Expected Result: শুধু electronics category-র item, price ascending-এ sorted। Other category item response-এ থাকবে না। Sort order filter applied data-র মধ্যে correct।

TC-SORT-031: Sort + Multiple Filters

Query: category=electronics&status=active&minPrice=1000&sort=rating&order=desc

Expected Result: সব filter apply-এর পর remaining data rating descending-এ sorted। Filter logic AND/OR documented behavior অনুযায়ী।

TC-SORT-032: Sort + Search Combined

Query: search=phone&sort=price&order=asc

Expected Result: Search result set-এর মধ্যে price ascending sort। Search relevance score sort-এর সাথে conflict হলে documented priority — price sort override করবে search ranking।

TC-SORT-033: Sort After Filter Returns Empty

Query: category=nonexistent&sort=price&order=asc

Expected Result: 200 OK, empty array — sort parameter empty result-এ error throw করবে না।

---

Sort + Pagination — সবচেয়ে Critical Test Area

Sorting bug-এর 60%+ pagination-এর সাথে combine হলে ধরা পড়ে। User page 2-এ গেলে order ভেঙে গেলে experience সম্পূর্ণ ruin হয়।

TC-SORT-034: Page 1 and Page 2 Order Continuity

Steps:

  1. GET /api/products?sort=price&order=asc&page=1&pageSize=10 — result save করুন
  2. GET /api/products?sort=price&order=asc&page=2&pageSize=10 — result save করুন

Expected Result: Page 1-এর last item price <= Page 2-এর first item price। কোনো overlap (duplicate ID) বা gap (missing record) হবে না।

TC-SORT-035: All Pages Combined — Full Order Verification

Steps: Total 45 record, pageSize=10 — সব 5 page fetch করে একত্র করুন।

Expected Result: Combined list globally sorted (price asc)। Duplicate ID zero। Missing record zero। Total count metadata-র সাথে match।

TC-SORT-036: Sort Change Resets Pagination

Scenario: User page 3-এ আছে, sort direction change করে desc-এ।

Expected Result: UI page 1-এ reset হবে — page 3 desc order-এ meaningless data দেখাবে না। API level-এ sort change-এ page param validate — out-of-range gracefully handle।

TC-SORT-037: Cursor-Based Pagination with Sort

Scenario: API cursor-based pagination use করে (after=cursor123&sort=createdAt&order=desc)।

Expected Result: Cursor next page-এ sort order maintain। Cursor invalid/expired হলে 400 with clear message। Sort change করলে previous cursor invalid — documented behavior।

TC-SORT-038: Sort + Pagination + Filter — Triple Combination

Query: category=books&sort=price&order=asc&page=2&pageSize=5

Expected Result: Filtered subset-এ page 2 correctly sorted। Page 1-এর last price <= Page 2-এর first price। Total count filtered count reflect করবে, full dataset count নয়।

---

Multi-Column Sort Tests

TC-SORT-039: Two-Column Sort

Query: sort=category,price&order=asc,desc

Expected Result: প্রথমে category A-Z, same category-র মধ্যে price descending। Category boundary-তে price order reset হবে — global price order নয়।

TC-SORT-040: Three-Column Sort

Query: sort=category,rating,price&order=asc,desc,asc

Expected Result: Priority order: category → rating → price। Each level tie-break next level-এ।

TC-SORT-041: Mismatched Sort/Order Count

Query: sort=category,price&order=asc (only one order for two fields)

Expected Result: 400 Bad Request অথবা missing order-এ documented default apply — silent wrong multi-sort acceptable নয়।

TC-SORT-042: Multi-Column — Duplicate Sort Fields

Query: sort=price,price&order=asc,desc

Expected Result: 400 Bad Request — redundant sort rejected। Undefined behavior acceptable নয়।

---

UI & API Consistency Tests

TC-SORT-043: UI Sort Indicator Matches API

Steps: UI-তে "Price: Low to High" click করুন। Network tab-এ actual API call inspect করুন।

Expected Result: API call: sort=price&order=asc। UI arrow/icon direction match করবে। Mismatch হলে frontend bug।

TC-SORT-044: Sort Toggle — Asc to Desc

Steps: Same column header দুইবার click — asc → desc toggle।

Expected Result: First click: asc। Second click: desc। Third click: asc (cycle) — documented UX pattern। API parameter correctly update।

TC-SORT-045: Default Sort on Page Load

Expected Result: Page load-এ default sort apply — API spec-এ define (e.g., createdAt desc)। User sort change না করলেও meaningful order — random database order acceptable নয়।

TC-SORT-046: Sort Persistence After Navigation

Steps: Sort apply করুন, detail page-এ যান, back করুন।

Expected Result: Previous sort selection restore হবে — URL query param বা session state-এ persist। User sort preference হারাবে না।

---

Performance & Scalability Tests

TC-SORT-047: Sort Response Time — Small Dataset

Scenario: 100 records, sort=price&order=asc

Expected Result: Response time < 200ms (SLA adjust করুন)। Acceptable user experience।

TC-SORT-048: Sort Response Time — Large Dataset

Scenario: 100,000+ records, sort=createdAt&order=desc&page=1&pageSize=20

Expected Result: Response within SLA (< 500ms) — database index sort field-এ আছে কিনা verify। Full table scan হলে timeout risk।

TC-SORT-049: Sort on Unindexed Field

Scenario: Computed/virtual field sort — index নেই।

Expected Result: Performance degradation documented। Extreme slow query-তে timeout gracefully — 504 with message, hung request নয়।

TC-SORT-050: Concurrent Sort Requests

Steps: 20 user simultaneously different sort parameter-এ request করুন।

Expected Result: প্রতিটি user correct sorted result পাবে — cross-request contamination হবে না। Server stable থাকবে।

---

Data Integrity Tests

TC-SORT-051: Total Count Consistency Across Sorts

Steps: sort=price&order=asc total count vs sort=name&order=desc total count compare করুন।

Expected Result: Total count identical — sorting record add/remove করবে না। Metadata total field accurate।

TC-SORT-052: Sort Does Not Duplicate Records

Steps: All pages fetch করে unique ID count vs total compare।

Expected Result: Unique ID count == total। JOIN query bug-এ duplicate common — sort test দিয়ে catch possible।

TC-SORT-053: Sort Stability Under Data Update

Scenario: Page 1 fetch করার পর backend-এ new record insert, তারপর Page 2 fetch।

Expected Result: Eventual consistency documented — real-time system-এ duplicate/skip possible, but acknowledge in spec। Strong consistency claim থাকলে verify no skip/duplicate।

---

Test Automation Strategy

Sorting manually verify tedious — automation দিয়ে regression catch efficient।

  • Order Assertion Script: API response array iterate করে consecutive pair compare — asc/desc violation instant detect।
  • Cross-Page Validation: All pages fetch করে global order verify — pagination bug automated catch।
  • Property-Based Testing: Random dataset generate করে sort apply — order invariant programmatically check।
  • UI + API Sync: Playwright/Cypress-এ sort click → network intercept → parameter match assert।
  • Performance Baseline: k6/JMeter-এ sort endpoint load test — SLA regression detect।

Pro Tip:

Sorting test suite-এ TC-SORT-034 (Page 1 & Page 2 continuity) এবং TC-SORT-035 (full pagination order) — এ দুটোকে highest priority দিন। Production bug report-এর majority pagination + sort combination থেকে আসে, isolated sort test pass থেকে।

---

Bug Report Template — Sorting Issues

Sorting bug report করার সময় developer reproduce করতে এই information দিন:

  • Exact API URL with sort, order, filter, pagination parameters
  • Expected order (first 3 এবং last 3 item-এর field value)
  • Actual order (same positions)
  • Dataset size (total record count)
  • Specific record ID যেটা wrong position-এ
  • UI screenshot + Network tab API response
  • Sort field data type (numeric stored as string কিনা)
---

পরিশেষে

Sorting Testing-কে "data আসছে তো" level-এ রাখলে Production-এ user complaint inevitable। সবচেয়ে critical তিনটি area:

  1. Sort + Pagination continuity — page boundary-তে order break হওয়া সবচেয়ে common bug
  2. NULL ও tie-breaking behavior — equal value-তে random order user confuse করে
  3. Locale ও data type correctness — Bengali name, numeric string, floating point

এই 53টি test case functional validation, security, performance, UI consistency — সব dimension cover করে। Release-এর আগে minimum TC-SORT-001 থেকে TC-SORT-006 (basic sort) এবং TC-SORT-034, TC-SORT-035 (pagination continuity) mandatory regression suite-এ রাখুন।
